title: Colors, images, SVG and point clouds
text: color_using_background_image() fills VMobject matching part image, given file array values [0, 1]. two shapes share one gradient image:
code: BackgroundColored <- R6::R6Class("BackgroundColored", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     x <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)     img <- array(0, c(200, 200, 3))     img[, , 1] <- outer(x, x, function(a, b) a)     img[, , 2] <- outer(x, x, function(a, b) b)     img[, , 3] <- 0.6     sq <- Square(side_length = 3, fill_opacity = 1)$shift(3 * LEFT)     ci <- Circle(radius = 1.5, fill_opacity = 1)$shift(3 * RIGHT)     VGroup(sq, ci)$color_using_background_image(img)     self$play(DrawBorderThenFill(sq), DrawBorderThenFill(ci), run_time = 1.5)     self$play(Rotate(sq, PI / 4), ci$animate$shift(LEFT), run_time = 1)   }) )

title: Colors, images, SVG and point clouds
text: ImageMobject() shows raster image. accepts PNG file name, numeric array values 0 255 (matrix gray, h x w x 3 h x w x 4 array), raster .raster(), nativeRaster, character matrix colors. Images stored RGBA arrays values 0 255. size follows scale_to_resolution: image shown pixel pixel vertical resolution (1080 default), 64 pixel tall image 64 / 1080 * 8 units tall. Set height width (use scale()) resize; images move, scale rotate like mobject.
code: gray <- ImageMobject(matrix(c(0, 100, 30, 200, 255, 0, 5, 33), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) dim(gray$pixel_array) #> [1] 2 4 4 z <- outer(seq(-2, 2, length.out = 60), seq(-2, 2, length.out = 90), function(y, x) sin(x^2 + y^2)) heat <- ImageMobject(matrix(hcl.colors(100, "Plasma")[cut(z, 100)], nrow = 60)) dim(heat$get_pixel_array()) #> [1] 60 90  4 png_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png") rgb_array <- array(0, c(64, 64, 3)) rgb_array[, , 1] <- outer(1:64, 1:64, function(i, j) i / 64) rgb_array[, , 2] <- outer(1:64, 1:64, function(i, j) j / 64) rgb_array[, , 3] <- 0.5 png::writePNG(rgb_array, png_file) from_file <- ImageMobject(png_file) from_native <- ImageMobject(png::readPNG(png_file, native = TRUE)) from_raster <- ImageMobject(as.raster(rgb_array)) c(from_file$width, from_file$height) #> [1] 0.4740741 0.4740741 for (img in list(gray, heat, from_file)) img$height <- 2.5 from_native$height <- 1.2 from_raster$height <- 1.2 from_native$rotate(PI / 8) plot(Group(gray, heat, from_file, Group(from_native, from_raster)$arrange(DOWN))$arrange(RIGHT, buff = 0.4))

title: Colors, images, SVG and point clouds
text: image drawn larger pixels, set_resampling_algorithm() decides gaps filled. accepted names listed RESAMPLING_ALGORITHMS. Pillow’s transform Python manim, "nearest" shows sharp pixel blocks, "bilinear" blends neighboring pixels linearly "bicubic" (default) uses Pillow’s bicubic filter, little sharper; "lanczos", "box" "hamming" drawn "bilinear". set_opacity() makes image transparent, invert = TRUE inverts colors, image_mode converts image read file: "RGBA" (default), "RGB" (drops alpha channel) "L" (luminance, gray).  get_raster() returns image array [0, 1], ready grid::grid.raster(), get_pixel_array() returns stored 0 255 array.
code: RESAMPLING_ALGORITHMS #>    nearest       none    lanczos  antialias   bilinear     linear    bicubic  #>  "nearest"  "nearest"  "lanczos"  "lanczos" "bilinear" "bilinear"  "bicubic"  #>      cubic        box    hamming  #>  "bicubic"      "box"  "hamming" tiny <- matrix(c(0, 255, 60, 200, 120, 30, 255, 90, 160), 3) blocky <- ImageMobject(tiny)$set_resampling_algorithm("nearest") smooth <- ImageMobject(tiny)$set_resampling_algorithm("bilinear") behind <- Square(side_length = 2.2, color = YELLOW, fill_opacity = 1) faded <- ImageMobject(png_file)$set_opacity(0.4) inverted <- ImageMobject(png_file, invert = TRUE) luminance <- ImageMobject(png_file, image_mode = "L") for (img in list(blocky, smooth, faded, inverted, luminance)) img$height <- 2 faded$move_to(behind) plot(Group(blocky, smooth, Group(behind, faded), inverted, luminance)$arrange(RIGHT, buff = 0.3)) dim(heat$get_raster()) #> [1] 60 90  4 range(heat$get_raster()) #> [1] 0 1

title: Colors, images, SVG and point clouds
text: ImageMobject() creates object class ImageMobjectClass, inherits AbstractImageMobjectClass (base class shares ImageMobjectFromCameraClass); subclass generators image mobjects . Images take part animations like mobjects. Transform two images pixel size blends pixels:
code: ImageAnimation <- R6::R6Class("ImageAnimation", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     x <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 80)     pattern <- function(f, palette) {       z <- outer(x, x, f)       matrix(hcl.colors(64, palette)[cut(z, 64)], nrow = length(x))     }     rings <- ImageMobject(pattern(function(a, b) sin(a^2 + b^2), "Viridis"))     waves <- ImageMobject(pattern(function(a, b) sin(2 * a) + cos(3 * b), "Plasma"))     for (img in list(rings, waves)) img$height <- 5     self$play(FadeIn(rings), run_time = 1)     self$play(rings$animate$rotate(PI / 4)$scale(0.8), run_time = 1)     self$play(Transform(rings, waves$rotate(PI / 4)$scale(0.8)), run_time = 1.5)   }) )

title: Colors, images, SVG and point clouds
text: Three helpers manim.utils.images work 0 255 image arrays. change_to_rgba_array() adds missing channels, invert_image() returns 255 - image (alpha included, upstream) drag_pixels() fills black pixels frame frames came , leaving trail.  top row shows five frames moving block, bottom row drag_pixels() makes .
code: dim(change_to_rgba_array(matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 4), 2))) #> [1] 2 2 4 change_to_rgba_array(array(100, c(1, 1, 3)))[1, 1, ] #> [1] 100 100 100 255 invert_image(array(c(0, 255, 100, 255), c(1, 1, 4)))[1, 1, ] #> [1] 255   0 155   0 frames <- lapply(1:5, function(k) {   a <- array(0, c(10, 20, 3))   a[4:7, (4 * k - 3):(4 * k - 1), ] <- 255 * k / 5   a }) trail <- drag_pixels(frames) show_row <- function(arrays) Group(lapply(arrays, function(a) {   img <- ImageMobject(a)$set_resampling_algorithm("nearest")   img$height <- 1.2   Group(img, SurroundingRectangle(img, buff = 0, color = GREY_C, stroke_width = 2)) }))$arrange(RIGHT, buff = 0.2) plot(Group(show_row(frames), show_row(trail))$arrange(DOWN, buff = 0.4))

what: A background image for the scene
title: Colors, images, SVG and point clouds
text: camera can draw image instead plain background color: pass background_image (file name array values [0, 1]) scene created. Override initialize() scene class . image drawn pixel size top left corner, stretched, make large frame; config$pixel_width config$pixel_height give size current render.
code: SkyScene <- R6::R6Class("SkyScene", inherit = Scene,   public = list(     initialize = function(...) {       h <- config$pixel_height       w <- config$pixel_width       shade <- seq(0, 1, length.out = h)       sky <- array(0, c(h, w, 3))       sky[, , 1] <- 0.1 * shade       sky[, , 2] <- 0.2 + 0.3 * shade       sky[, , 3] <- 0.5 + 0.4 * (1 - shade)       super$initialize(background_image = sky, ...)     },     construct = function() {       star <- Star(color = YELLOW, fill_opacity = 1)$shift(2 * LEFT + DOWN)       self$play(GrowFromCenter(star), run_time = 1)       self$play(star$animate$move_to(2 * RIGHT + UP)$scale(1.5), run_time = 1.5)     }   ) )

title: Colors, images, SVG and point clouds
text: ImageMobjectFromCamera() shows second camera sees. building block ZoomedScene (see Cameras 3D), can used directly: give scene MultiCameraClass camera, make MovingCameraClass camera, wrap ImageMobjectFromCamera(), register add_image_mobject_from_camera(). Moving second camera’s frame changes display shows.
code: PictureInPicture <- R6::R6Class("PictureInPicture", inherit = MovingCameraScene,   public = list(     default_camera_class = function() MultiCameraClass,     construct = function() {       shapes <- VGroup(Circle(fill_opacity = 1, color = RED), Square(fill_opacity = 1, color = BLUE),                        Triangle(fill_opacity = 1, color = GREEN))$arrange(RIGHT)$shift(2 * LEFT + DOWN)       cam <- MovingCameraClass$new(default_frame_stroke_width = 3)       display <- ImageMobjectFromCamera(cam)       display$add_display_frame()       for (mob in list(cam$frame, display)) {         mob$stretch_to_fit_height(2.5)         mob$stretch_to_fit_width(3.5)       }       cam$frame$scale(0.6)$move_to(shapes[1])       display$to_corner(UR)       self$camera$add_image_mobject_from_camera(display)       self$add(shapes, cam$frame, display)       self$play(cam$frame$animate$move_to(shapes[3]), run_time = 2)     }   ) )

title: Colors, images, SVG and point clouds
text: SVGMobject() reads SVG file group VMobjects, one per shape. Paths, rectangles, circles, ellipses, lines, polylines, polygons, groups, <use> references, transforms, CSS styles fill stroke attributes supported; <text> elements skipped warning, upstream (convert text paths first). file written temporary file example self contained. default result centered scaled height = 2; pass height width choose size should_center = FALSE keep file’s position. Style arguments override file’s styles, svg_default sets style elements set .  middle copy strokes, stroke parts (ground line, bird smoke) disappear. shape submobject, index change one part:  use_svg_cache = TRUE (default) reuses earlier import file, path_string_config passes options path parser. class generators SVGMobjectClass VMobjectFromSVGPathClass; import step method, subclass can change one .
code: svg_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".svg") writeLines(c(   '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 160">',   '  <style>.wall { fill: #F7D96F; stroke: #FFFFFF; stroke-width: 2; }</style>',   '  <rect class="wall" x="40" y="70" width="120" height="80"/>',   '  <polygon points="30,72 100,15 170,72" fill="#FC6255"/>',   '  <rect x="88" y="105" width="24" height="45" fill="#8B4513"/>',   '  <circle cx="65" cy="98" r="12" fill="#58C4DD" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>',   '  <ellipse cx="135" cy="98" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#58C4DD"/>',   '  <line x1="0" y1="150" x2="200" y2="150" stroke="#83C167" stroke-width="4"/>',   '  <polyline points="15,35 25,27 35,35 45,27 55,35" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>',   '  <g transform="translate(130 10) scale(0.5)">',   '    <path d="M 10 40 C 10 10, 50 10, 50 40 S 90 70, 90 40" fill="none" stroke="#BBBBBB" stroke-width="6"/>',   '  </g>',   '</svg>'), svg_file) house <- SVGMobject(svg_file, height = 4) print_family(house) #>  SVGMobject 3cf82af63f7916cfd8-523 #>   Rectangle 3cf82af63f7916cfd8-528 #>   Polygon 3cf82af63f7916cfd8-531 #>   Rectangle 3cf82af63f7916cfd8-533 #>   Circle 3cf82af63f7916cfd8-536 #>   Circle 3cf82af63f7916cfd8-538 #>   Line 3cf82af63f7916cfd8-540 #>   VMobject 3cf82af63f7916cfd8-542 #>   VMobjectFromSVGPath 3cf82af63f7916cfd8-545 plain <- SVGMobject(svg_file, height = 4, stroke_width = 0) recolored <- SVGMobject(svg_file, height = 4, fill_color = GREY_B, stroke_color = WHITE, stroke_width = 1) row <- VGroup(house$copy(), plain, recolored)$arrange(RIGHT, buff = 0.3) row$width <- 13 plot(row) length(house) #> [1] 8 class(house[2])[1] #> [1] "Polygon" house[2]$set_fill(PURPLE) house[4]$set_fill(ORANGE) plot(house)

title: Colors, images, SVG and point clouds
text: VMobjectFromSVGPath() turns d attribute SVG <path> VMobject directly. keeps SVG coordinates, y grows downward, flip result (SVGMobject() ):  long_lines, should_subdivide_sharp_curves should_remove_null_curves accepted compatibility upstream’s OpenGL renderer.

title: Colors, images, SVG and point clouds
text: Point cloud mobjects made points rather curves: point drawn small square stroke_width pixels wide, color. colors stored rgbas matrix, one RGBA row per point. PMobject() empty cloud. add_points(points, rgbas, color, alpha) appends points one color color per point. Mobject1D(density) adds add_line(start, end, color), samples segment density points per unit. Mobject2D(density) two dimensional version, cloud density per unit area. PointCloudDot(center, radius, density) fills disc rings points, Point(location) single point. PGroup() groups point clouds. class generators, subclassing, PMobjectClass, Mobject1DClass, Mobject2DClass, PointCloudDotClass, PointClass PGroupClass. methods thin_out(factor) (keep every factorth point), filter_out(condition) (drop points condition(point) true), sort_points(fn) fade_to(color, alpha) reshape cloud: Points measured pixels, point clouds best seen rendered scene. one shows clouds reshapes :
code: set.seed(7) cloud <- PMobject(stroke_width = 3) cloud$add_points(cbind(rnorm(500, sd = 0.7), rnorm(500, sd = 0.7), 0)) dim(cloud$points) #> [1] 500   3 dim(cloud$rgbas) #> [1] 500   4 cloud$set_colors_by_radial_gradient(radius = 2.5, inner_color = YELLOW, outer_color = RED) tri <- Mobject1D(density = 20, stroke_width = 4) corners <- list(c(-1, -1, 0), c(1, -1, 0), c(0, 0.8, 0)) for (k in 1:3) tri$add_line(corners[[k]], corners[[k %% 3 + 1]], color = c(BLUE, GREEN, PURPLE)[k]) grid_pts <- as.matrix(expand.grid(x = seq(-1, 1, by = 1 / 5), y = seq(-1, 1, by = 1 / 5), z = 0)) patch <- Mobject2D(density = 5, stroke_width = 4) patch$add_points(grid_pts, color = TEAL) disc <- PointCloudDot(radius = 1, density = 12, stroke_width = 3) disc$set_color_by_gradient(BLUE, GREEN) nrow(disc$points) #> [1] 478 thin <- disc$copy()$thin_out(3) nrow(thin$points) #> [1] 160 half <- disc$copy()$filter_out(function(p) p[1] > 0) nrow(half$points) #> [1] 233 cloud$copy()$sort_points(function(p) p[2])$points[1, ] # the lowest point #> [1] -0.9455574 -1.8350181  0.0000000 PointClouds <- R6::R6Class("PointClouds", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     group <- PGroup(cloud, tri, patch, disc, Point(c(0, 3, 0), color = WHITE))     cloud$move_to(4.5 * LEFT)     tri$move_to(1.5 * LEFT)     patch$move_to(1.5 * RIGHT)     disc$move_to(4.5 * RIGHT)     self$play(FadeIn(group), run_time = 1)     self$play(Rotate(tri, PI), cloud$animate$fade_to(BLUE, 0.6),               disc$animate$filter_out(function(p) p[2] < disc$get_center()[2]), run_time = 1.5)   }) )

title: Colors, images, SVG and point clouds
text: Upstream’s OpenGL renderer point clouds, drawn round dots radius stroke_width / 100 units. ported scenes written run; manimR draws renderer everything else. OpenGLPMobject() empty cloud; add points add_points(). OpenGLPMPoint(location) single dot. DotCloud(radius, density) fills disc rings dots. make_3d() stores upstream’s gloss shadow, affect upstream’s shader. TrueDot() DotCloud; upstream, initializer ends making default cloud radius 2 origin. OpenGLPGroup() groups OpenGL point clouds. generators OpenGLPMobjectClass, OpenGLPMPointClass, DotCloudClass, TrueDotClass OpenGLPGroupClass.
code: ring <- OpenGLPMobject(color = GREEN, stroke_width = 8) theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 25)[-25] ring$add_points(cbind(cos(theta), sin(theta), 0)) dots <- DotCloud(radius = 1, density = 6, color = BLUE) dots$make_3d() true_dot <- TrueDot(color = RED)$scale(0.5) pair <- OpenGLPGroup(OpenGLPMPoint(LEFT / 2, stroke_width = 20, color = YELLOW),                      OpenGLPMPoint(RIGHT / 2, stroke_width = 20, color = PINK)) c(nrow(dots$points), nrow(true_dot$points), dots$gloss) #> [1]  166.0 1303.0    0.5 plot(Group(ring, dots, true_dot, pair)$arrange(RIGHT, buff = 0.6))

what: The same scene in both languages
title: Coming from Python manim
text: short Python scene: scene R: differences mechanical: class R6 class inherits Scene; construct function class’s public list, self available inside without argument; methods called $ instead .; keyword arguments use = spaces convention, assignment uses <-; group[0] becomes group[1], R counts 1. Constructors, method names, argument names, constants (BLUE, RIGHT, PI) animation names unchanged.
code: from manim import *  class SquareAndCircle(Scene):     def construct(self):         circle = Circle(radius=1, color=BLUE).set_fill(BLUE, opacity=0.5)         square = Square(side_length=2, color=GREEN)         square.next_to(circle, RIGHT, buff=0.5)         group = VGroup(circle, square).move_to(ORIGIN)         self.play(Create(circle), FadeIn(square), run_time=1.5)         self.play(square.animate.rotate(PI / 4).set_fill(GREEN, opacity=0.8))         self.play(group[0].animate.shift(UP))         self.wait(0.5) SquareAndCircle <- R6::R6Class("SquareAndCircle", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     circle <- Circle(radius = 1, color = BLUE)$set_fill(BLUE, opacity = 0.5)     square <- Square(side_length = 2, color = GREEN)     square$next_to(circle, RIGHT, buff = 0.5)     group <- VGroup(circle, square)$move_to(ORIGIN)     self$play(Create(circle), FadeIn(square), run_time = 1.5)     self$play(square$animate$rotate(PI / 4)$set_fill(GREEN, opacity = 0.8))     self$play(group[1]$animate$shift(UP))     self$wait(0.5)   }) )

code: class UpdaterDemo(Scene):     def construct(self):         angle = ValueTracker(0)         hand = Line(ORIGIN, 2 * RIGHT, color=YELLOW)         hand.add_updater(lambda m: m.become(             Line(ORIGIN, 2 * np.array([np.cos(angle.get_value()), np.sin(angle.get_value()), 0]), color=YELLOW)))         spinner = Square(side_length=0.6, color=BLUE).shift(4 * LEFT)         spinner.add_updater(lambda m, dt: m.rotate(dt * PI))         label = always_redraw(lambda: Text(f"{angle.get_value() / DEGREES:.0f} degrees", font_size=32).to_edge(DOWN))         self.add(Circle(radius=2, color=GREY), hand, spinner, label)         self.play(angle.animate.set_value(PI), run_time=2)         angle += -PI / 2         self.wait(0.5) UpdaterDemo <- R6::R6Class("UpdaterDemo", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     angle <- ValueTracker(0)     hand <- Line(ORIGIN, 2 * RIGHT, color = YELLOW)     hand$add_updater(function(m) m$become(       Line(ORIGIN, 2 * c(cos(angle$get_value()), sin(angle$get_value()), 0), color = YELLOW)))     spinner <- Square(side_length = 0.6, color = BLUE)$shift(4 * LEFT)     spinner$add_updater(function(m, dt) m$rotate(dt * PI))     label <- always_redraw(function() {       Text(sprintf("%.0f degrees", angle$get_value() / DEGREES), font_size = 32)$to_edge(DOWN)     })     self$add(Circle(radius = 2, color = GREY), hand, spinner, label)     self$play(angle$animate$set_value(PI), run_time = 2)     angle$increment_value(-PI / 2)     self$wait(0.5)   }) )

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: NumberLine() draws line ticks. range x_range = c(min, max, step); step sets tick spacing. Give drawn length length distance consecutive integers unit_size.  arguments shown: numbers_with_elongated_ticks (values whose ticks longer_tick_multiple times longer), include_tip, tick_size (half tick length), rotation (radians), stroke_width color (passed underlying Line()). exclude_origin_tick = TRUE leaves tick zero include_ticks = FALSE .
code: plain <- NumberLine(x_range = c(-5, 5, 1), length = 10) fine <- NumberLine(   x_range = c(-5, 5, 0.5), length = 10, color = BLUE,   numbers_with_elongated_ticks = -5:5, longer_tick_multiple = 2.5,   include_tip = TRUE, tip_width = 0.2, tip_height = 0.2 ) tilted <- NumberLine(x_range = c(0, 4, 1), unit_size = 1.2, rotation = 20 * DEGREES,                      stroke_width = 4, tick_size = 0.2, color = YELLOW) plot(VGroup(plain, fine, tilted)$arrange(DOWN, buff = 0.8))

code: integers <- NumberLine(x_range = c(-3, 3, 1), length = 9, include_numbers = TRUE,                        numbers_to_exclude = 0) quarters <- NumberLine(x_range = c(0, 1, 0.25), length = 9, include_numbers = TRUE,                        label_direction = UP, font_size = 30, color = TEAL) percent <- NumberLine(x_range = c(0, 100, 25), length = 9, include_numbers = TRUE,                       decimal_number_config = list(num_decimal_places = 0, unit = "\\%")) plot(VGroup(integers, quarters, percent)$arrange(DOWN, buff = 1)) line <- NumberLine(x_range = c(0, 10, 1), length = 10) line$add_numbers(x_values = c(0, 5, 10), font_size = 32) line$add_labels(list("2" = "start", "8" = Text("end", font_size = 28, color = RED)),                 direction = UP) seven <- line$get_number_mobject(7, direction = DOWN, font_size = 48)$set_color(YELLOW) plot(VGroup(line, seven))

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: ax$plot() takes x_range = c(min, max, step): domain sampling step (default tenth tick step); discontinuities dt: values curve broken, far side stop; use_smoothing: smooth sampled points Bezier curves (TRUE); use_vectorized = TRUE: call f x values (faster vectorized R functions); colorscale colorscale_axis: color graph y (axis 2) x (axis 1) values; style arguments color stroke_width.
code: ax <- Axes(x_range = c(-4, 4, 1), y_range = c(-4, 4, 1), x_length = 7, y_length = 7)$scale(0.95) hyperbola <- ax$plot(function(x) 1 / x, x_range = c(-4, 4, 0.01),                      discontinuities = 0, dt = 0.25, color = RED) cubic <- ax$plot(function(x) x^3 / 4 - x, x_range = c(-2.9, 2.9),                  colorscale = c(BLUE, GREEN, YELLOW, ORANGE), use_vectorized = TRUE,                  stroke_width = 6) plot(VGroup(ax, hyperbola, cubic))

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: plot_line_graph(x_values, y_values) joins data points straight segments returns VDict entries "line_graph" "vertex_dots". upstream’s heat diagram:
code: ax <- Axes(x_range = c(0, 40, 5), y_range = c(-8, 32, 5), x_length = 9, y_length = 6,            x_axis_config = list(numbers_to_include = seq(0, 35, 5)),            y_axis_config = list(numbers_to_include = seq(-5, 30, 5)), tips = FALSE) labels <- ax$get_axis_labels(x_label = Tex("$\\Delta Q$"), y_label = Tex("T[$^\\circ C$]")) graph <- ax$plot_line_graph(x_values = c(0, 8, 38, 39), y_values = c(20, 0, 0, -5),                             line_color = GOLD, vertex_dot_style = list(color = RED)) plot(VGroup(ax, labels, graph))

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: get_area(graph, x_range) fills region graph x axis, two graphs bounded_graph. get_riemann_rectangles(graph, x_range, dx) approximates area rectangles; input_sample_type ("left", "right" "center") picks rectangle meets graph, color gradient across rectangles, show_signed_area inverts color rectangles axis, bounded_graph measures second graph. get_vertical_line(point) drops dashed line point x axis.  classic Riemann sum animation refines rectangles become area curve:
code: ax <- Axes(x_range = c(0, 5), y_range = c(0, 6),            x_axis_config = list(numbers_to_include = c(2, 3)), tips = FALSE) labels <- ax$get_axis_labels() curve_1 <- ax$plot(function(x) 4 * x - x^2, x_range = c(0, 4), color = BLUE_C) curve_2 <- ax$plot(function(x) 0.8 * x^2 - 3 * x + 4, x_range = c(0, 4), color = GREEN_B) line_1 <- ax$get_vertical_line(ax$input_to_graph_point(2, curve_1), color = YELLOW) line_2 <- ax$get_vertical_line(ax$i2gp(3, curve_1), color = YELLOW) riemann_area <- ax$get_riemann_rectangles(curve_1, x_range = c(0.3, 0.6), dx = 0.03,                                           color = BLUE, fill_opacity = 0.5) area <- ax$get_area(curve_2, c(2, 3), bounded_graph = curve_1, color = GREY, opacity = 0.5) plot(VGroup(ax, labels, curve_1, curve_2, line_1, line_2, riemann_area, area)) RiemannSum <- R6::R6Class("RiemannSum", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     ax <- Axes(x_range = c(0, 5, 1), y_range = c(0, 5, 1), x_length = 9, y_length = 6, tips = FALSE)     f <- ax$plot(function(x) 0.2 * (x - 1) * (x - 3) * (x - 4.5) + 2.5, x_range = c(0.2, 5), color = YELLOW)     rects <- lapply(c(0.5, 0.25, 0.1), function(dx) {       ax$get_riemann_rectangles(f, x_range = c(0.5, 4.5), dx = dx, input_sample_type = "center",                                 color = c(BLUE, TEAL, GREEN), fill_opacity = 0.7, stroke_width = 0.5)     })     area <- ax$get_area(f, x_range = c(0.5, 4.5), color = c(BLUE, GREEN), opacity = 0.7)     self$add(ax)     self$play(Create(f), run_time = 1)     self$play(Create(rects[[1]]), run_time = 1)     for (k in 2:3) self$play(Transform(rects[[1]], rects[[k]]), run_time = 0.8)     self$play(FadeOut(rects[[1]]), FadeIn(area), run_time = 0.8)   }) )

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: methods compute numbers rather mobjects: slope_of_tangent() angle_of_tangent() measured axes’ coordinates. graph$underlying_function function plotted, graph$func maps value scene point.
code: ax <- Axes(x_range = c(-3, 3, 1), y_range = c(-1, 9, 1)) parabola <- ax$plot(function(x) x^2) ax$input_to_graph_coords(2, parabola)   # alias i2gc() #> [1] 2 4 ax$p2c(ax$i2gp(2, parabola)) #> [1] 2 4 ax$slope_of_tangent(2, parabola) #> [1] 4 ax$angle_of_tangent(2, parabola) / DEGREES #> [1] 75.96376 parabola$underlying_function(3) #> [1] 9

what: Lines to graphs, T labels and secants
title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: get_vertical_line(), get_horizontal_line() get_lines_to_point() (built get_line_from_axis_to_point(index, point)) draw dashed lines default; line_func = Line gives solid ones, color, stroke_width line_config style . get_vertical_lines_to_graph() draws num_lines evenly spaced lines get_T_label() triangle marker optional label . get_secant_slope_group(x, graph, dx) builds classic picture secant: dx dy legs, optional labels, secant line.  Shrinking dx turns secant tangent. updater made always_redraw() rebuilds group every frame:
code: ax <- Axes(x_range = c(0, 6, 1), y_range = c(0, 4, 1), x_length = 10, y_length = 6, tips = FALSE) g <- ax$plot(function(x) 2 + sin(x), color = BLUE) fan <- ax$get_vertical_lines_to_graph(g, x_range = c(0.5, 2.5), num_lines = 9, color = TEAL) t_label <- ax$get_T_label(x_val = 4, graph = g, triangle_color = YELLOW, line_color = YELLOW) h_line <- ax$get_horizontal_line(ax$i2gp(5, g), color = RED) v_line <- ax$get_vertical_line(ax$i2gp(5, g), line_func = Line, color = RED) plot(VGroup(ax, g, fan, t_label, h_line, v_line)) ax <- Axes(x_range = c(0, 4, 1), y_range = c(0, 7, 1), x_length = 8, y_length = 6, tips = FALSE) f <- ax$plot(function(x) 0.4 * x^2 + 0.5, color = BLUE) secant <- ax$get_secant_slope_group(x = 1.5, graph = f, dx = 1.5, dx_label = "dx", dy_label = "dy",                                     secant_line_length = 6, secant_line_color = YELLOW) plot(VGroup(ax, f, secant)) SecantToTangent <- R6::R6Class("SecantToTangent", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     ax <- Axes(x_range = c(0, 4, 1), y_range = c(0, 7, 1), x_length = 8, y_length = 6, tips = FALSE)     f <- ax$plot(function(x) 0.4 * x^2 + 0.5, color = BLUE)     dx <- ValueTracker(2)     secant <- always_redraw(function() {       ax$get_secant_slope_group(x = 1.5, graph = f, dx = dx$get_value(),                                 secant_line_length = 6, secant_line_color = YELLOW)     })     self$add(ax, f, secant)     self$play(dx$animate$set_value(0.01), run_time = 2)   }) )

what: A moving tangent line and the derivative
title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: plot_derivative_graph(graph) plots slope graph plot_antiderivative_graph(graph, y_intercept) integral (computed numerically). animation tangent line slides along curve dot traces derivative: dot’s height always tangent’s slope. axes use one unit per coordinate directions, slopes screen equal slopes coordinates. helpers return ordinary graphs, labels areas work :
code: MovingTangent <- R6::R6Class("MovingTangent", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     ax <- Axes(x_range = c(-5, 5, 1), y_range = c(-3, 3, 1), x_length = 10, y_length = 6)     f <- ax$plot(function(x) sin(x) + 0.3 * x, color = BLUE)     df <- ax$plot_derivative_graph(f, color = GREEN)     x <- ValueTracker(-4)     tangent <- always_redraw(function() {       Line(LEFT, RIGHT, color = YELLOW)$set_length(3)$         rotate(ax$angle_of_tangent(x$get_value(), f))$         move_to(ax$i2gp(x$get_value(), f))     })     on_f <- always_redraw(function() Dot(ax$i2gp(x$get_value(), f), color = YELLOW))     on_df <- always_redraw(function() Dot(ax$i2gp(x$get_value(), df), color = GREEN))     self$add(ax, f, df, tangent, on_f, on_df)     self$play(x$animate$set_value(4), run_time = 3, rate_func = linear)   }) ) ax <- Axes(x_range = c(0, 6.5, 1), y_range = c(-1.5, 3, 1), x_length = 10, y_length = 6, tips = FALSE) f <- ax$plot(sin, x_range = c(0, 6.5), color = BLUE) df <- ax$plot_derivative_graph(f, color = GREEN) big_f <- ax$plot_antiderivative_graph(f, y_intercept = 0, color = ORANGE) labels <- VGroup(   ax$get_graph_label(f, "f(x) = \\sin x", x_val = 4.5, direction = DOWN),   ax$get_graph_label(df, "f'(x)", x_val = 5.2, direction = UP),   ax$get_graph_label(big_f, "F(x)", x_val = 2.6, direction = UL, dot = TRUE) ) plot(VGroup(ax, f, df, big_f, labels))

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: NumberPlane() Axes grid. default covers whole frame one unit per square. background_line_style styles grid lines faded_line_ratio adds fainter lines (2 means one faint line per cell). get_vector(coords) draws arrow origin.  grid lines plane$background_lines plane$faded_lines. plane can bent function points. Straight lines two anchors, call prepare_for_nonlinear_transform() first give enough points curve smoothly:
code: plane <- NumberPlane(   x_range = c(-7, 7, 1), y_range = c(-4, 4, 1),   background_line_style = list(stroke_color = TEAL, stroke_width = 2, stroke_opacity = 0.6),   faded_line_ratio = 2 ) v <- plane$get_vector(c(3, 2), color = YELLOW) w <- plane$get_vector(c(-2, 1), color = RED) plot(VGroup(plane, v, w)) PlaneWarp <- R6::R6Class("PlaneWarp", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     grid <- NumberPlane()     self$add(grid)     grid$prepare_for_nonlinear_transform()     self$play(grid$animate$apply_function(function(p) {       p + c(sin(p[2]), sin(p[1]), 0)     }), run_time = 2)   }) )

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: PolarPlane() draws circles rays. radius_max radius_step set circles, size diameter screen, azimuth_step number rays, azimuth_units angle labels: "PI radians", "TAU radians", "degrees", "gradians" NULL (plain fractions turn). azimuth_compact_fraction, azimuth_offset, azimuth_direction ("CCW" "CW"), azimuth_label_buff azimuth_label_font_size fine tune labels. add_coordinates() writes ; get_coordinate_labels() returns without adding, get_radian_label(number) builds one angle label.  plane$pr2pt(r, theta) turns polar coordinates scene point:
code: radians <- PolarPlane(radius_max = 2, size = 5, azimuth_units = "PI radians", azimuth_step = 8) radians$add_coordinates() degrees <- PolarPlane(radius_max = 2, size = 5, azimuth_units = "degrees", azimuth_step = 12,                       azimuth_direction = "CW", radius_config = list(font_size = 20)) degrees$add_coordinates() rose <- radians$plot_polar_graph(function(th) 2 * sin(3 * th), theta_range = c(0, PI), color = PINK) plot(VGroup(VGroup(radians, rose), degrees)$arrange(RIGHT, buff = 1.5)) plane <- PolarPlane(radius_max = 3) plane$pr2pt(2, PI / 2) #> [1] 1.224647e-16 2.000000e+00 0.000000e+00 plane$pt2pr(c(0, 2, 0)) #> [1] 2.000000 1.570796

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: ComplexPlane() NumberPlane addressed complex numbers: n2p() takes complex number p2n() returns one. add_coordinates() takes complex numbers labels imaginary axis ; without arguments labels get_default_coordinate_values(), get_coordinate_labels() returns labels without adding .  ApplyComplexFunction(f, mobject) animates mobject complex function: every point x + iy moves f(x + iy). grid squared: mobject method apply_complex_function() without animation. works scene coordinates, complex coordinates plane centered one unit per step:
code: plane <- ComplexPlane(x_range = c(-4, 4, 1), y_range = c(-3, 3, 1), x_length = 8, y_length = 6) plane$add_coordinates(-3:3, complex(imaginary = c(-2, -1, 1, 2))) z <- complex(real = 1.5, imaginary = 0.5) dots <- VGroup(Dot(plane$n2p(z), color = YELLOW), Dot(plane$n2p(z^2), color = RED)) labels <- VGroup(MathTex("z")$next_to(dots[1], UR, buff = 0.1),                  MathTex("z^2")$next_to(dots[2], UR, buff = 0.1)) plot(VGroup(plane, dots, labels)) plane <- ComplexPlane() plane$n2p(complex(real = 2, imaginary = 1)) #> [1] 2 1 0 plane$p2n(c(-1, 3, 0)) #> [1] -1+3i ComplexSquare <- R6::R6Class("ComplexSquare", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     plane <- ComplexPlane(x_range = c(-2, 2, 0.5), y_range = c(-2, 2, 0.5), x_length = 4, y_length = 4,                           background_line_style = list(stroke_color = BLUE, stroke_width = 2))     plane$prepare_for_nonlinear_transform()     self$add(plane)     self$play(ApplyComplexFunction(function(z) z^2 / 2, plane), run_time = 2)   }) ) plane <- ComplexPlane(x_range = c(-7, 7, 1), y_range = c(-4, 4, 1)) circle <- Circle(radius = 1, color = YELLOW) image <- circle$copy()$apply_complex_function(exp)$set_color(RED) plot(VGroup(plane, circle, image))

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: ThreeDAxes() adds z axis, z_range, z_length z_axis_config; get_z_axis() returns get_z_axis_label() labels . Every plotting method works 3D (third coordinate makes sense), plot_surface() draws z = f(x, y). need ThreeDScene viewed angle, covered Cameras 3D scenes. quick taste, helix drawn plot_parametric_curve():
code: Helix <- R6::R6Class("Helix", inherit = ThreeDScene,   public = list(construct = function() {     axes <- ThreeDAxes(x_range = c(-3, 3, 1), y_range = c(-3, 3, 1), z_range = c(0, 4, 1),                        x_length = 6, y_length = 6, z_length = 4)     helix <- axes$plot_parametric_curve(function(t) c(2 * cos(t), 2 * sin(t), t / 4),                                         t_range = c(0, 4 * PI, 0.05), color = YELLOW)     self$set_camera_orientation(phi = 70 * DEGREES, theta = -50 * DEGREES, zoom = 0.8,                                 frame_center = c(0, 0, 1.5))     self$add(axes)     self$play(Create(helix), run_time = 2)   }) )

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: Three mobjects draw curves directly scene coordinates: ParametricFunction(func, t_range): func(t) returns c(x, y) c(x, y, z); t_range = c(min, max, step). use_vectorized = TRUE function receives t values returns coordinate rows, rbind(x, y, z). discontinuities, dt, use_smoothing scaling work ax$plot(). FunctionGraph(f, x_range): y = f(x), default across whole frame. ImplicitFunction(f, x_range, y_range): curve f(x, y) = 0. min_depth max_quads set sampling resolution.  function graph stays available: get_function() returns function gave, graph$func (get_point_from_function(t)) point function.
code: lissajous <- ParametricFunction(function(t) c(2 * sin(2 * t), 1.6 * sin(3 * t), 0),                                 t_range = c(0, TAU, 0.01), color = ORANGE) spiral <- ParametricFunction(function(t) rbind(t / 10 * cos(t), t / 10 * sin(t), 0),                              t_range = c(0, 6 * PI, 0.05), use_vectorized = TRUE, color = TEAL) heart <- ImplicitFunction(function(x, y) (x^2 + y^2 - 1)^3 - x^2 * y^3,                           x_range = c(-1.5, 1.5), y_range = c(-1.5, 1.5), color = RED)$scale(1.6) VGroup(lissajous, spiral, heart)$arrange(RIGHT, buff = 0.8)$shift(0.8 * UP) wave <- FunctionGraph(function(x) 0.4 * cos(2 * x), x_range = c(-7, 7), color = BLUE)$shift(2.9 * DOWN) plot(VGroup(lissajous, spiral, heart, wave)) wave$get_function()(0) #> [1] 0.4 lissajous$func(PI / 4) #> [1] 2.000000 1.131371 0.000000 c(lissajous$t_min, lissajous$t_max) #> [1] 0.000000 6.283185

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: BarChart(values, bar_names) Axes one bar per value. y range computed values unless give y_range. bar_colors gradient spread across bars, bar_width, bar_fill_opacity bar_stroke_width style . get_bar_labels() returns values labels () bars. upstream’s example:  bars chart$bars. change_bar_values() resizes (update_colors() reapplies gradient), $animate change animated:
code: chart <- BarChart(   values = c(-5, 40, -10, 20, -3),   bar_names = c("one", "two", "three", "four", "five"),   y_range = c(-20, 50, 10), y_length = 6, x_length = 10,   x_axis_config = list(font_size = 36) ) bar_labels <- chart$get_bar_labels(font_size = 48) plot(VGroup(chart, bar_labels)) BarChartChange <- R6::R6Class("BarChartChange", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     chart <- BarChart(c(3, 5, 2, 6), bar_names = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),                       y_range = c(0, 8, 2), y_length = 5, x_length = 8)     self$add(chart)     self$play(chart$animate$change_bar_values(c(6, 2, 7, 3)), run_time = 1.5)     self$play(chart$bars[1]$animate$set_color(YELLOW), run_time = 0.5)   }) )

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: SampleSpace() rectangle drawing probabilities areas. divide_horizontally(p_list) divide_vertically(p_list) split parts proportional probabilities (missing last part added sum 1, see complete_p_list()), space[] returns part , SampleSpace can divided . get_horizontal_division() get_vertical_division() return parts without adding , add_title() writes title space. get_side_braces_and_labels(), get_top_braces_and_labels() get_bottom_braces_and_labels() make braces labels parts division, add_braces_and_labels() adds space:
code: space <- SampleSpace(width = 6, height = 4) space$divide_horizontally(0.3, colors = c(GREEN_E, BLUE_E)) lower <- space[2] lower$divide_vertically(0.6, colors = c(MAROON_B, YELLOW)) space$add_title("Sample space") side <- space$get_side_braces_and_labels(c("P(A)", "P(\\bar{A})")) bottom <- lower$get_bottom_braces_and_labels(c("P(B|\\bar{A})", "P(\\bar{B}|\\bar{A})")) plot(VGroup(space, side, bottom)$move_to(ORIGIN))

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: Graph(vertices, edges) draws graph sense graph theory: vertices (default Dot()s) joined edges (default Line()s). DiGraph() draws directed graph arrows. Vertices named strings (numbers converted), edges pairs names given list two column matrix. manimR computes layouts (ports networkx layouts), graph package needed.

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: layout one names , named list positions, function function(graph, scale, ...) returning list. layout_scale half width layout layout_config passes extra settings . binary tree every layout:  root_vertex partitions can also given directly Graph().
code: vertices <- 1:7 edges <- list(c(1, 2), c(1, 3), c(2, 4), c(2, 5), c(3, 6), c(3, 7)) configs <- list(   spring = list(seed = 1), circular = list(), kamada_kawai = list(), planar = list(),   random = list(seed = 2), shell = list(nlist = list(1, 2:3, 4:7)), spectral = list(),   spiral = list(), tree = list(root_vertex = 1), partite = list(partitions = list(1, 2:3, 4:7)) ) panels <- lapply(names(configs), function(layout) {   g <- Graph(vertices, edges, layout = layout, layout_scale = 1, layout_config = configs[[layout]],              vertex_config = list(radius = 0.07), edge_config = list(stroke_width = 2))   VGroup(g, Text(layout, font_size = 22)$next_to(g, DOWN, buff = 0.25)) }) plot(VGroup(panels)$arrange_in_grid(rows = 2, buff = c(0.6, 0.5)))

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: network lives igraph object, GraphClass$from_igraph(g, ...) DiGraphClass$from_igraph(g, ...) build Graph DiGraph vertices (name, names) edges; arguments go constructor. R counterpart upstream’s Graph.from_networkx(). Zachary’s karate club network, comes igraph:
code: karate <- igraph::make_graph("Zachary") club <- GraphClass$from_igraph(karate, layout = "kamada_kawai", layout_scale = 3.5,                                vertex_config = list(radius = 0.1, fill_color = TEAL),                                edge_config = list(stroke_width = 1.5, stroke_opacity = 0.6)) club$get(1)$set_color(YELLOW) club$get(34)$set_color(RED) plot(club) club #> Undirected graph on 34 vertices and 78 edges

what: Vertex and edge styles, labels and custom positions
title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: vertex_config list arguments vertex constructor; entry named vertex replaces defaults vertex . edge_config works way edges, entries named "u-v". labels = TRUE writes vertex names vertices MathTex() (vertices become LabeledDot()s); named list mobjects gives labels. vertex_type edge_type choose mobjects, example vertex_type = Square.  Look vertex g$get("") (g$vertices[[""]]) edge g$get(c("", "c")). vertex_ids(), neighbors(v) is_tree() answer questions structure. Moving vertex drags edges along, graph keeps attached updater.
code: ids <- c("a", "b", "c", "d") text_labels <- setNames(lapply(ids, function(v) Text(v, font_size = 30, color = BLACK)), ids) g <- Graph(   ids, list(c("a", "b"), c("b", "c"), c("c", "d"), c("d", "a"), c("a", "c")),   layout = list(a = c(-2, 1.5, 0), b = c(2, 1.5, 0), c = c(2, -1.5, 0), d = c(-2, -1.5, 0)),   labels = text_labels,   vertex_config = list(fill_color = BLUE_B, d = list(fill_color = RED_B)),   edge_config = list(stroke_width = 4, "a-c" = list(color = YELLOW, stroke_width = 8)) )$shift(3.5 * LEFT) dg <- DiGraph(   1:4, list(c(1, 2), c(2, 3), c(3, 4), c(4, 1), c(1, 3)),   layout = "circular", layout_scale = 2,   vertex_type = Square, vertex_config = list(side_length = 0.5, fill_opacity = 1, fill_color = TEAL),   edge_config = list(tip_config = list(tip_length = 0.25, tip_width = 0.25),                      "1-3" = list(color = ORANGE)) )$shift(3.5 * RIGHT) plot(VGroup(g, dg)) g #> Undirected graph on 4 vertices and 5 edges

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: add_vertices(), remove_vertices(), add_edges() remove_edges() change graph (remove_vertex(), add_edge() remove_edge() handle one time), change_layout() moves vertices new layout. $animate animated: new vertices edges drawn Create(), removed ones Uncreate(), layout change moves vertices smoothly. Pass animation settings g$animate(run_time = 2)$..., another animation g$animate(animation = FadeIn)$....
code: GraphChanges <- R6::R6Class("GraphChanges", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     g <- Graph(1:4, list(c(1, 2), c(2, 3), c(3, 4)), layout = "circular", layout_scale = 2,                vertex_config = list(radius = 0.15))     self$play(Create(g), run_time = 1)     self$play(g$animate$add_vertices(5, 6, positions = list("5" = c(-4, 0, 0), "6" = c(4, 0, 0))),               run_time = 0.8)     self$play(g$animate$add_edges(c(4, 5), c(5, 6), c(6, 1)), run_time = 0.8)     self$play(g$animate$change_layout("circular", layout_scale = 2.5), run_time = 1)     self$play(g$get(1)$animate$shift(1.5 * RIGHT), run_time = 0.8)     self$play(g$animate$remove_edges(c(6, 1)), run_time = 0.8)     self$play(g$animate(animation = FadeOut)$remove_vertices(3), run_time = 0.8)   }) )

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: vector field function position c(x, y, z) vector. ArrowVectorField() draws grid arrows StreamLines() paths particles flowing . Unless color given, vectors colored length mapped onto gradient colors (default DEFAULT_SCALAR_FIELD_COLORS) min_color_scheme_value max_color_scheme_value; color_scheme replaces length function vector. methods eval_func(pos), pos_to_color(pos) pos_to_rgb(pos) field return vector position color.
code: DEFAULT_SCALAR_FIELD_COLORS #> [1] "#236B8E" "#83C167" "#F7D96F" "#FC6255"

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: x_range y_range (c(min, max, step)) set grid arrows, length_func maps vector’s length drawn length (default lengths squashed 0.45 arrows overlap), opacity fades , vector_config passed Vector(). left default coloring, right single color arrows fixed length:
code: func <- function(p) sin(p[2] / 2) * RIGHT + cos(p[1] / 2) * UP colored <- ArrowVectorField(func, x_range = c(-6.75, -0.75, 0.75), y_range = c(-3, 3, 0.75),                             min_color_scheme_value = 0.5, max_color_scheme_value = 1.4,                             colors = c(BLUE, GREEN, YELLOW, RED)) fixed <- ArrowVectorField(func, x_range = c(0.75, 6.75, 0.75), y_range = c(-3, 3, 0.75),                           color = YELLOW, length_func = function(norm) 0.4) plot(VGroup(colored, fixed))

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: nudge(mob, dt, substeps, pointwise) moves mobject along field time dt (center, every point separately pointwise = TRUE, deforms ). get_nudge_updater(speed, pointwise) returns updater every frame. upstream’s nudging example: circle dot first nudged two seconds backwards, flow forwards starting position (gray circle) beyond. VectorField() base class: field arrows . Give submobjects start_submobject_movement() keeps flowing stop_submobject_movement(); nudge_submobjects(dt) moves .
code: Nudging <- R6::R6Class("Nudging", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     func <- function(p) sin(p[2] / 2) * RIGHT + cos(p[1] / 2) * UP     field <- ArrowVectorField(func, x_range = c(-7, 7, 1), y_range = c(-4, 4, 1),                               length_func = function(x) x / 2)     self$add(field)     circle <- Circle(radius = 2)$shift(LEFT)     self$add(circle$copy()$set_color(GREY))     dot <- Dot()$move_to(circle)     field$nudge(circle, -2, 60, TRUE)     field$nudge(dot, -2, 60)     circle$add_updater(field$get_nudge_updater(pointwise = TRUE))     dot$add_updater(field$get_nudge_updater())     self$add(circle, dot)     self$wait(3)   }) ) FloatingDots <- R6::R6Class("FloatingDots", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     func <- function(p) c(-p[2], p[1], 0) / 2     self$add(ArrowVectorField(func, x_range = c(-7, 7, 1), y_range = c(-4, 4, 1), opacity = 0.4))     flow <- VectorField(func)     for (r in 1:3) flow$add(Dot(r * RIGHT, color = YELLOW, radius = 0.12))     self$add(flow)     flow$start_submobject_movement(speed = 1)     self$wait(2)     flow$stop_submobject_movement()   }) )

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: StreamLines(func) starts particle near every grid point (randomly jittered noise_factor, n_repeats particles per point) follows virtual_time steps dt. max_anchors_per_line, padding (far particles may leave grid) stroke_width shape lines. stream line field animated one two ways: self$play(stream_lines$create()) draws lines , random order; stream_lines$start_animation(warm_up, flow_speed, time_width, rate_func, line_animation_class) makes light flow along continuously scene waits, self$play(stream_lines$end_animation()) ends flow smoothly every line fully drawn. single lines StreamLineClass objects stream_lines$stream_lines.
code: ContinuousMotion <- R6::R6Class("ContinuousMotion", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     func <- function(p) sin(p[1] / 2) * UR + cos(p[2] / 2) * LEFT     stream_lines <- StreamLines(func, x_range = c(-7, 7, 1.4), y_range = c(-4, 4, 1.4),                                 stroke_width = 3, max_anchors_per_line = 30)     self$add(stream_lines)     stream_lines$start_animation(warm_up = FALSE, flow_speed = 1.5)     self$wait(1)     self$play(stream_lines$end_animation())   }) )

title: Graphs, plots and coordinate systems
text: vector_field_shift_func(func, shift_vector) vector_field_scale_func(func, scalar) return moved rescaled copy field function (methods field$shift_func() field$scale_func() ). fit_to_coordinate_system(axes) moves field built coordinates onto coordinate system:  get_colored_background_image(sampling_rate) samples field’s colors whole frame returns RGB array (rows top bottom), example draw .raster(); larger sampling_rate samples fewer pixels. get_vectorized_rgba_gradient_function(start, end, colors) returns function maps values RGBA rows along gradient.
code: swirl <- function(p) c(-p[2], p[1], 0) moved <- vector_field_shift_func(swirl, shift_vector = 2 * RIGHT) moved(c(2, 1, 0))        # the swirl now turns around (2, 0) #> [1] -1  0  0 finer <- vector_field_scale_func(swirl, scalar = 0.5) finer(c(2, 2, 0)) #> [1] -1  1  0 plane <- NumberPlane(x_range = c(-3, 3, 1), y_range = c(-2, 2, 1), x_length = 9, y_length = 6) field <- ArrowVectorField(swirl, x_range = c(-2.5, 2.5, 0.5), y_range = c(-1.5, 1.5, 0.5),                           length_func = function(n) 0.25) field$fit_to_coordinate_system(plane) plot(VGroup(plane, field)) field <- VectorField(function(p) c(p[2], -p[1], 0) / 3) img <- field$get_colored_background_image(sampling_rate = 40) dim(img) #> [1] 27 48  3 op <- par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0)) plot(as.raster(img)) par(op) gradient <- field$get_vectorized_rgba_gradient_function(0, 2, c(BLUE, RED)) gradient(c(0, 1, 2)) #>                                       opacity #> #58C4DD 0.3450980 0.7686275 0.8666667       1 #> #58C4DD 0.6666667 0.5764706 0.6000000       1 #> #FC6255 0.9882353 0.3843137 0.3333333       1

title: Getting started with manimR
text: Five ideas cover manimR. Mobjects (mathematical objects) things see: Circle(), Square(), Text(), Axes(), MathTex() formula. vectorized mobjects (VMobject), whose outlines made cubic Bezier curves. Mobjects can contain mobjects, groups VGroup() hold several . Scenes hold mobjects run show. write scene class construct() method; rendering scene calls construct(). Animations change mobjects time: Create() draws shape, Transform() morphs one shape another, FadeIn() fades . scene runs self$play() pauses self$wait(). camera turns scene pixels. frame 8 units tall , usual 16:9 aspect ratio, 14.2 units wide, origin middle, x right y . Positions units, scene looks every resolution. Rendering plays scene start finish, captures every frame writes output file. render() , options resolution, frame rate file format. Directions plain numeric vectors length 3: c(0, 1, 0) RIGHT c(1, 0, 0), 2 * + RIGHT point (1, 2). picture shows frame NumberPlane() grid (one square per unit), direction constants, two points labeled coordinates.
code: plane <- NumberPlane() arrows <- VGroup(   Arrow(ORIGIN, 2 * UP, buff = 0, color = YELLOW),   Arrow(ORIGIN, 2 * RIGHT, buff = 0, color = YELLOW) ) labels <- VGroup(   Text("UP", font_size = 28, color = YELLOW)$next_to(arrows[1], UP, buff = 0.1),   Text("RIGHT", font_size = 28, color = YELLOW)$next_to(arrows[2], RIGHT, buff = 0.1) ) corner <- function(point, label, direction) {   VGroup(     Dot(point, color = RED),     Text(label, font_size = 22, color = RED)$next_to(point, direction, buff = 0.15)   ) } corners <- VGroup(   corner(c(-6, 3, 0), "(-6, 3)", DR),   corner(c(6, -3, 0), "(6, -3)", UL) ) plot(VGroup(plane, arrows, labels, corners))

Use $copy() want independent copy, , black label copy original stays white. Every mobject stores outline $points, n x 3 matrix Bezier control points (four rows per cubic curve):

title: Getting started with manimR
text: scene R6 class inherits Scene defines construct() method. Inside construct(), self scene: self$play() runs one animations self$wait() holds current frame. Reading line line: R6::R6Class("SquareToCircle", inherit = Scene, ...) defines new scene class. first argument class name, also names output file. circle pink, half transparent circle, square square turned 45 degrees. Creating show yet. self$play(Create(square)) draws square’s outline adds scene. self$play(Transform(square, circle)) morphs square circle. mobject screen still square; now looks like circle. self$wait(0.5) holds last frame half second. play() lasts one second unless pass run_time, wait() defaults one second . vignette shows scenes knitr engine (see RStudio, knitr, Quarto Shiny); script render , shown Rendering .
code: SquareToCircle <- R6::R6Class("SquareToCircle", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     circle <- Circle()$set_fill(PINK, opacity = 0.5)     square <- Square()$rotate(PI / 4)     self$play(Create(square))     self$play(Transform(square, circle))     self$wait(0.5)   }) )

title: Getting started with manimR
text: quick experiments, manim_scene() builds scene class plain function whose argument scene: manim_scene() also takes setup function, run construct, base class MovingCameraScene. render() accepts bare function , wraps manim_scene() .
code: Shapes <- manim_scene(function(self) {   shapes <- VGroup(     Circle(color = BLUE)$set_fill(BLUE, 0.5),     Square(color = GREEN)$set_fill(GREEN, 0.5),     Triangle(color = RED)$set_fill(RED, 0.5)   )$arrange(RIGHT, buff = 1)   self$play(LaggedStart(lapply(shapes$submobjects, GrowFromCenter), lag_ratio = 0.3))   self$play(shapes$animate$arrange(DOWN, buff = 0.3)$scale(0.6), run_time = 1.5)   self$wait(0.5) }, name = "Shapes")

title: Getting started with manimR
text: methods return mobject, can describe whole layout one expression:  animate method call instead applying , put $animate mobject method. square$animate$shift(RIGHT) animation moves square right; chain several methods happen together. Arguments animation , run_time rate_func, go $animate(...): Several animations passed one self$play() run time. self$add() puts mobjects screen without animation. Named arguments self$play(), run_time = 1.5, apply every animation call.
code: dots <- VGroup(lapply(1:6, function(i) Dot(radius = 0.12 * i))) dots$arrange(RIGHT, buff = 0.4)$set_color_by_gradient(BLUE, GREEN, YELLOW)$to_edge(UP) title <- Text("Six dots", font_size = 40)$next_to(dots, DOWN, buff = 0.6) plot(VGroup(dots, title)) AnimateBuilder <- R6::R6Class("AnimateBuilder", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     square <- Square(color = BLUE)$set_fill(BLUE, 0.4)$shift(4 * LEFT)     circle <- Circle(color = YELLOW)$shift(3.5 * RIGHT)     self$add(square, circle)     self$play(square$animate$shift(3 * RIGHT)$rotate(PI / 4)$set_fill(GREEN, 0.8))     self$play(       circle$animate(rate_func = there_and_back)$scale(0.5),       square$animate$scale(1.5),       run_time = 1.5     )     self$wait(0.5)   }) )

title: Getting started with manimR
text: updater function runs every frame. ValueTracker holds number can animate; updaters read redraw whatever depends . dot follows tracker along number line, label rebuilt every frame always_redraw(): Updaters value trackers covers updaters depth.
code: Tracker <- R6::R6Class("Tracker", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     line <- NumberLine(x_range = c(-5, 5, 1), length = 10)     x <- ValueTracker(-4)     dot <- Dot(color = YELLOW)     dot$add_updater(function(m) m$move_to(line$number_to_point(x$get_value())))     label <- always_redraw(function() {       Text(sprintf("x = %.1f", x$get_value()), font_size = 32)$next_to(dot, UP)     })     self$add(line, dot, label)     self$play(x$animate$set_value(4), run_time = 2)     self$play(x$animate$set_value(1), run_time = 1)     self$wait(0.5)   }) )

title: Mobjects and geometry
text: mobject stores geometry points, n x 3 matrix one point per row. Vectorized mobjects (VMobjects, kind almost every shape ) chains cubic Bezier curves, stored four rows per curve: anchor, two handles next anchor. straight edge Bezier curve whose handles lie segment, top edge handles one third two thirds way. circle uses eight curves real handles: Mobject base class everything; VMobject adds Bezier paths, fill stroke. rarely create either directly, VMobject() starting point custom shapes.

title: Mobjects and geometry
text: mobject can contain mobjects, submobjects. mobject together submobjects, submobjects family. Moving, scaling coloring mobject applies whole family. print_family() shows tree member’s name id. index_labels() puts number submobject, helps need find part complicated mobject formula. labels count 1, face[] . Integer() numbers, typeset LaTeX default; mob_class = Text draws system font instead.
code: eyes <- VGroup(Dot(c(-0.5, 0.4, 0)), Dot(c(0.5, 0.4, 0))) mouth <- Arc(radius = 0.8, start_angle = PI + 0.6, angle = PI - 1.2, color = YELLOW) face <- VGroup(Circle(radius = 1.5, color = YELLOW), eyes, mouth)$scale(1.5) print_family(face) #>  VGroup 47472af640701a61e8-10 #>   Circle 47472af640701a61e8-9 #>   VGroup 47472af640701a61e8-7 #>       Dot 47472af640701a61e8-5 #>       Dot 47472af640701a61e8-6 #>   Arc 47472af640701a61e8-8 length(face$submobjects) #> [1] 3 length(face$get_family()) #> [1] 6 labels <- index_labels(face, mob_class = Text, label_height = 0.45) plot(VGroup(face, labels))

title: Mobjects and geometry
text: Every shape constructor function R6 class generator. Circle() function calls CircleClass$new(): use function make mobjects, generator subclass reach class methods. generators follow pattern FooClass. classes vignette : Base classes: MobjectClass, VMobjectClass, GroupClass, VGroupClass, VDictClass, VectorizedPointClass TipableVMobjectClass (anything can carry arrow tips). Arcs circles: ArcClass, ArcBetweenPointsClass, CircleClass, DotClass, EllipseClass, AnnularSectorClass, AnnulusClass. Lines arrows: LineClass, DashedLineClass, ArrowClass, VectorClass, AngleClass, ArrowTipClass tip classes shown . Polygons rectangles: PolygramClass, PolygonClass, RegularPolygramClass, RegularPolygonClass, TriangleClass, RectangleClass, SquareClass, RoundedRectangleClass, SurroundingRectangleClass, BackgroundRectangleClass, ScreenRectangleClass. Everything else: BooleanOpsClass UnionClass, IntersectionClass, DifferenceClass ExclusionClass; BraceClass BraceLabelClass; LabelClass, LabeledLineClass, LabeledArrowClass LabeledPolygramClass; CurvesAsSubmobjectsClass ManimBannerClass. constructors, Sector(), Star(), DoubleArrow(), CurvedArrow(), CubicBezier(), Cutout() DashedVMobject(), generator : build object parent class add name class vector, inherits() still recognizes . Upstream’s class methods live generators, example CircleClass$from_three_points() (also available circle_from_three_points()): set_default() changes constructor’s defaults reset , keeps long scene consistent:
code: c1 <- Circle(radius = 1) c2 <- CircleClass$new(radius = 1) class(c1) #> [1] "Circle"          "Arc"             "TipableVMobject" "VMobject"        #> [5] "Mobject"         "R6" inherits(c1, "Arc") #> [1] TRUE CircleClass$classname #> [1] "Circle" class(Star()) #> [1] "Star"     "Polygon"  "Polygram" "VMobject" "Mobject"  "R6" inherits(Sector(), "Sector") #> [1] TRUE CircleClass$from_three_points(LEFT, UP, RIGHT)$radius #> [1] 1 set_default(Circle, color = BLUE, fill_opacity = 0.5) Circle()$get_color() #> [1] "#58C4DD" Circle()$get_fill_opacity() #> [1] 0.5 set_default(Circle) # restore the original defaults Circle()$get_color() #> [1] "#FC6255"
