title: Math and utility functions
text: R function one number works rate function. usually return 0 t = 0 1 t = 1, animation starts ends expected. unit_interval() clamps function 0 start 1 end, zero() makes 0 outside [0, 1]; upstream’s decorators. Plotted little beyond [0, 1], clamped version stays 0 1 outside unit interval. Animations ever evaluate t inside , clamping matters call rate function .  race moves five dots distance time different rate functions. there_and_back returns start, dot ends began.
code: three_steps <- function(t) (floor(3 * t) + smooth_rate((3 * t) %% 1)) / 3 power_rate <- function(p) function(t) t^p # a factory, like not_quite_there() cubed <- power_rate(3) clamped <- unit_interval(function(t) t^2) c(three_steps(0.5), cubed(0.5), clamped(1.5), zero(function(t) t^2)(1.5)) #> [1] 0.500 0.125 1.000 0.000 op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(2, 2, 2, 0.5), mgp = c(2, 0.4, 0), tcl = -0.2, cex.main = 0.9) fs <- list(three_steps = three_steps, `power_rate(3)` = cubed, `unit_interval(t^2)` = clamped) for (nm in names(fs)) {   x <- seq(-0.2, 1.2, length.out = 281)   plot(x, vapply(x, fs[[nm]], numeric(1)), type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "#236B8E", main = nm, xlab = "", ylab = "")   abline(v = c(0, 1), col = "grey70", lty = 3) } par(op) RateRace <- R6::R6Class("RateRace", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     funcs <- list(linear = linear, smooth_rate = smooth_rate, there_and_back = there_and_back,                   ease_out_bounce = ease_out_bounce, three_steps = three_steps)     cols <- c(BLUE, GREEN, YELLOW, ORANGE, RED)     dots <- list()     for (i in seq_along(funcs)) {       y <- 2.4 - (i - 1) * 1.2       label <- Text(names(funcs)[i], font_size = 26, color = cols[i])$move_to(c(-4.6, y, 0))       track <- Line(c(-2.5, y, 0), c(5.5, y, 0), color = GREY_D, stroke_width = 2)       dots[[i]] <- Dot(c(-2.5, y, 0), radius = 0.15, color = cols[i])       self$add(label, track, dots[[i]])     }     self$play(lapply(seq_along(funcs), function(i) {       dots[[i]]$animate(rate_func = funcs[[i]])$shift(8 * RIGHT)     }), run_time = 2)     self$wait(0.3)   }) )

title: Math and utility functions
text: Transform, every point travels going. path function decides route: takes start points, end points progress alpha, returns points moment. *_path() constructor returns function. straight_path() moves straight line (default). path_along_arc(arc_angle, axis) swings along circular arc arc_angle radians; positive angles turn counterclockwise. clockwise_path() counterclockwise_path() half turns. path_along_circles(arc_angle, circles_centers, axis) turns every point center choose also slides toward target. target exactly start turned center, shape deforms way: scene , dot shrinks point halfway, points meets opposite one. spiral_path(angle, axis) moves toward target rotating, points spiral . Pass path function animation path_func. Transform() also takes path_arc, shortcut path_along_arc() (path_arc_axis, path_arc_centers); ClockwiseTransform() CounterclockwiseTransform() use half turns. path function ordinary R function, can sample draw route point take. scene six choices, drawing route gray, runs six transforms .
code: straight_path() #> function (start, end, alpha)  #> (1 - alpha) * start + alpha * end #> <bytecode: 0x6113b8788a18> #> <environment: namespace:manimR> start <- rbind(LEFT) end <- rbind(RIGHT) zapsmall(straight_path()(start, end, 0.5)) #>      [,1] [,2] [,3] #> LEFT    0    0    0 zapsmall(path_along_arc(PI)(start, end, 0.5)) #>      [,1] [,2] [,3] #> LEFT    0   -1    0 zapsmall(clockwise_path()(start, end, 0.5)) #>      [,1] [,2] [,3] #> LEFT    0    1    0 zapsmall(counterclockwise_path()(start, end, 0.5)) #>      [,1] [,2] [,3] #> LEFT    0   -1    0 zapsmall(spiral_path(PI)(start, end, 0.5)) #>      [,1] [,2] [,3] #> LEFT   -1   -1    0 zapsmall(path_along_circles(PI, circles_centers = ORIGIN)(start, end, 0.5)) #>      [,1] [,2] [,3] #> LEFT    0   -1    0 route <- function(path, a, b) {   pts <- t(vapply(seq(0, 1, length.out = 60), function(al) as.numeric(path(rbind(a), rbind(b), al)), numeric(3)))   VMobject(color = GREY_C, stroke_width = 3)$set_points_as_corners(pts) } PathCompare <- R6::R6Class("PathCompare", inherit = Scene,   public = list(construct = function() {     panels <- list(       list(label = "straight_path()", center = c(-4.6, 1.2, 0), args = list(path_func = straight_path())),       list(label = "clockwise_path()", center = c(0, 1.2, 0), args = list(path_func = clockwise_path())),       list(label = "counterclockwise_path()", center = c(4.6, 1.2, 0),            args = list(path_func = counterclockwise_path())),       list(label = "path_arc = PI / 2", center = c(-4.6, -2.3, 0), args = list(path_arc = PI / 2)),       list(label = "spiral_path(PI)", center = c(0, -2.3, 0), args = list(path_func = spiral_path(PI))),       list(label = "path_along_circles()", center = c(4.6, -2.3, 0),            args = list(path_func = path_along_circles(PI, c(4.6, -1.8, 0))))     )     cols <- c(BLUE, GREEN, YELLOW, ORANGE, RED, PURPLE)     anims <- list()     for (i in seq_along(panels)) {       pnl <- panels[[i]]       a <- pnl$center + LEFT       b <- pnl$center + RIGHT       path <- pnl$args$path_func %||% path_along_arc(pnl$args$path_arc)       dot <- Dot(a, color = cols[i], radius = 0.12)       title <- Text(pnl$label, font_size = 22)$move_to(pnl$center + c(0, if (i <= 3) 1.6 else 1, 0))       self$add(title, route(path, a, b), Circle(radius = 0.12, color = GREY_B)$move_to(b), dot)       anims[[i]] <- do.call(Transform, c(list(dot, dot$copy()$move_to(b)), pnl$args))     }     self$play(anims, run_time = 2)     self$wait(0.3)   }) )

title: manimR 0.1.0
text: First release: native R port Manim Community 0.22 (Cairo style renderer), covering every public name class method manim import * (checked tests/testthat/test-api-coverage.R). Every upstream class R6 generator FooClass, including ones upstream defines preset arguments. Rendered output LaTeX cache go media folder R session’s temporary directory unless media_dir set, nothing written working directory default; manim_cli() writes media folder tools::R_user_dir("manimR", "cache") unless --media_dir given (--media_dir media writes ./media Manim’s command line ). Output follows Manim 0.22’s render sessions: format "auto", "mp4", "mov", "webm", "gif", "png" (last frame), "png-sequence" "none", dry_run, directory templates (get_dir()), manim.cfg files (digest_config_file()), encoder settings per scene log files. Partial movie files cached hash play, sections, sound subtitles written upstream. Tex() MathTex() LaTeX dvisvgm, Typst() MathTypst() typst compiler, Text() MarkupText() system fonts, Code() highlighted Pygments Python . command line (manim_cli()) takes manim render’s options checkhealth, cfg, init, plugins cache clear subcommands. RStudio addins (including rendering background job), manim knitr engine R Markdown Quarto, printing render() results documents, Shiny output functions (manimOutput(), renderManim()) interactive Shiny window scenes. as_mobject() turns ggplot2, grid base graphics mobjects, scene_frame() renders one frame scene, expect_snapshot_frame() tests frames testthat, GraphClass$from_igraph() imports igraph graphs. mobject classes upstream’s OpenGL renderer (OpenGLCircle(), OpenGLVGroup(), OpenGLSurface() rest) build Cairo counterparts, code written renderer runs unchanged; OpenGLSurfaceMesh() OpenGLTexturedSurface() ported grid. also methods argument names upstream’s OpenGL classes, including CPU side GPU pipeline: shader data, triangulation, uniforms ShaderWrapper(), upstream’s GLSL files. OpenGL class differs Cairo counterpart, follows upstream’s OpenGL class: OpenGLArrow() filled shape, OpenGLLine() applies buff twice, arcs made quadratic pieces, OpenGLArc(), OpenGLCircle(), OpenGLRectangle() others take upstream’s arguments upstream’s order. Images drawn homography corners Pillow’s nearest, bilinear bicubic filters, image seen edge skipped upstream. Helpers manim.utils outside manim import * exported : matrices manim.utils.opengl (orthographic_projection_matrix(), view_matrix() rest), rotation_matrix_transpose(), rotation_matrix_from_quaternion(), normalize_along_axis(), resize_array(), resize_preserving_order(), resize_with_interpolation(), batch_by_property(), uniq_chain(), get_smooth_closed_cubic_bezier_handle_points(), get_smooth_open_cubic_bezier_handle_points(), get_quadratic_approximation_of_cubic(), remove_invisible_chars() convert_audio(). ImplicitFunction() traces curve port adaptive quadtree isosurfaces package, ConvexHull() ConvexHull3D() use port upstream’s QuickHull, give upstream’s curve points hull faces. Submobjects validated inserted upstream: VMobject takes VMobjects, add(), add_to_back() insert() move mobject already submobject, insert() takes negative positions. numeric vector 3 4 values one color wherever color taken (Square(color = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))), single number hex number (0xFC6255); several colors character vector list. frame_width, frame_height frame_center camera properties: MovingCamera read move frame. SVGMobject() reads styles paths upstream’s SVG parser : shape stroke keeps stroke color class, opacity property replaces alpha color 8 bits, opacity property read, arc becomes one quadratic piece every tenth turn. MarkupText() rejects unknown tags, polylabel() also returns size h cell pole.
